allow.reason: Development-only test runner (not installed in the runtime image). The advisory concerns shared /tmp/pytest-of-<user> directories on multi-user UNIX hosts; the quality gate runs on single-user developer machines and ephemeral CI runners. The fix is pytest 9.0.3, a major upgrade that pyproject.toml deliberately caps below 9; the upgrade is a reviewed follow-up, not part of P11.

Development-only test runner chain (vitest 3.2.7 -> tinypool 1.1.1), never part of the built UI or the runtime image. The advisories describe a prototype-pollution gadget that needs an attacker to control the options passed to the worker pool; the tests here pass fixed options and run only trusted repository code. The fix is a major upgrade to vitest 5; it was attempted during P11 and its worker pool failed to start in this environment, so it was reverted. Re-assess when vitest 5 is validated.
